genesis.9.p1.b1.text: Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.

genesis.9.p1.b2.text: The fear and dread of you will fall on every living creature on the earth, every bird of the air …

genesis.9.p1.b3.text: Everything that lives and moves will be food for you; just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you all things.

genesis.9.p1.b4.text: … for in His own image God has made mankind.

genesis.9.p2.b5.text: “Behold, I now establish My covenant with you and your descendants after you,

genesis.9.p2.b6.text: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock, and every beast of the earth—every living thing that came out of the ark.

genesis.9.p2.b7.text: Never again will all life be cut off by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.

genesis.9.p3.b8.text: I have set My rainbow in the clouds, and it will be a sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.

genesis.9.p3.b9.text: … Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.

genesis.9.p3.b10.text: This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between Me and every creature on the earth.

genesis.9.p4.b11.text: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.

genesis.9.p4.b12.text: These three were the sons of Noah, and from them the whole earth was populated.

genesis.9.p5.b13.text: Now Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.

genesis.9.p5.b14.text: But when he drank some of its wine, he became drunk …

genesis.9.p5.b15.text: … and uncovered himself inside his tent.

genesis.9.p6.b16.text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father’s nakedness and told his two brothers outside.

genesis.9.p6.b17.text: Then Shem and Japheth took a garment and placed it across their shoulders, and walking backward, they covered their father’s nakedness.

genesis.9.p6.b18.text: Their faces were turned away so that they did not see their father’s nakedness.

genesis.9.p7.b19.text: Cursed be Canaan! A servant of servants shall he be to his brothers.

genesis.9.p7.b20.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem! … May God expand the territory of Japheth; may he dwell in the tents of Shem …

genesis.9.p7.b21.text: After the flood, Noah lived 350 years. So Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
